svg.text: of the Mihran family, not the House of Sasan —
of the Ispahbudhan family; uncle of Khosrow II
general who seized the throne for forty days
Boran and Azarmidokht, both daughters of Khosrow II, reigned as queens in their own right and issued coinage in their own names.
Ardashir I's link back to Sasan is a claim made by the dynasty itself; the Middle Persian and Arabic sources disagree over whether Sasan was Papak's father or a more distant forebear.
Between 628 and 632 at least ten rulers held the throne; only the securely attested Sasanian claimants are shown here.
